deployments_detail.use: AI drug discovery on 3,500+ NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs ("AI factories" with Omniverse); CDO Wafaa Mamilli disclosure
AI for next-gen diagnostics development (Roche/NVIDIA joint)

Roche NVIDIA AI Factory: deployed 3,500+ NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs across on-premises (US/Europe) and hybrid cloud to power biological foundation models and the 'Lab-in-the-Loop' drug discovery strategy, connecting AI models with biological and chemistry experiments. AI is integrated into nearly 90% of Genentech's eligible small-molecule programs. [NVIDIA (Blackwell GPUs, BioNeMo)]

Genentech gRED Research Agent: an agentic AI system for biomarker validation and drug target identification, processing scientific queries across PubMed and internal repositories to accelerate research from weeks to minutes. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock Agents), Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet]
deployments_detail.value: expected to automate 43,000+ hours of manual biomarker validation effort per year

deployments_detail.use: navify Digital Pathology open environment: integration of 20+ third-party AI image-analysis algorithms from 8 collaborators (Deep Bio, DiaDeep, Lunit, Mindpeak, Owkin, Qritive, Sonrai Analytics, Stratipath) into Roche's enterprise pathology software to support cancer diagnosis across prostate, breast, lung, colorectal, gastric, esophageal and bladder cancers. [Roche navify; partners Lunit, Owkin, Mindpeak, Deep Bio, Qritive, Sonrai, Stratipath, DiaDeep]

Roche Digital Pathology Dx (VENTANA DP 200) with AI-based uPath whole-slide image analysis algorithms; FDA 510(k) cleared to aid pathologists in reviewing and interpreting scanned pathology slides for diagnosis. [Roche (uPath, VENTANA)]

Accu-Chek SmartGuide predictive continuous glucose monitoring integrated with the mySugr app ('mySugr Glucose Insights'): AI predicts glucose levels up to 2 hours ahead during the day and up to 7 hours overnight for diabetes management. CE marked. [Roche Diabetes Care (Accu-Chek SmartGuide, mySugr)]
deployments_detail.value: predicts up to 2h daytime / 7h overnight; rolled out to 13 countries, expanding to 30+; mySugr has 6M+ accounts

deployments_detail.use: Roche + Ibex Medical Analytics + AWS collaboration to deploy AI-enabled digital pathology (Ibex algorithms for breast and prostate biopsy cancer diagnosis) via Roche's navify Digital Pathology, hosted on AWS cloud. [Ibex Medical Analytics, AWS, Roche navify]

Roche Tissue Diagnostics + PathAI exclusive collaboration to develop AI-enabled digital pathology algorithms for companion diagnostics, deployed via Roche's Digital Pathology solution to support precision medicine and drug development. [PathAI, Roche Tissue Diagnostics]

Genomics diagnostics using NVIDIA Parabricks accelerated computing software to derive insights across vast genomic datasets, and NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails to ensure safe healthcare-grade conversational AI in Roche's digital health products. [NVIDIA (Parabricks, NeMo Guardrails)]

Manufacturing digital twins: NVIDIA Omniverse-powered virtual replicas of production lines used to optimize processes and factory design, already accelerating development of Roche's new GLP-1 manufacturing facility in North Carolina. [NVIDIA Omniverse]

RocheChat: a secure enterprise 'AI Companion App' built on GPT foundational models with a vendor-agnostic, private architecture, providing generative AI for content creation and translation to Roche employees. Paired with LUMIN, a modular domain-specific AI assistant, serving 17,000+ users daily. [Roche Informatics (GPT foundation models); LUMIN built on OutSystems]
